changes.change: [picture] Rewrote the text: the correct sign is now identified by its slope rising to the right; the A5 sign is described as the one with the same 10 % whose slope falls to the right.
changes.reason: Both slope signs in the answers show 10 %, so 'the similar sign with 10 % is A5' did not tell the learner which picture is A6. The pictures confirm the official answer: the first sign rises to the right (A6), the second falls to the right (A5).

changes.change: [factual] Rewrote the text: the sign is recognised by the letter Е before the number, and the text now says that the sign „А 2“ is green as well, but is Ж20.1. Kept the three references.
changes.reason: In the picture „Е 79“ is green too, so calling „А 2“ 'the green sign' did not tell the two apart. Under чл. 146, ал. 3, т. 8 of the signs ordinance, Ж21 is green on motorways and expressways. The letter Е for roads of the international (European) network is not in the corpus, but it is plain, certain common knowledge and it is the only thing that tells the signs apart.

changes.change: [picture] 'Синият символ на фар' became 'Символът на фар …, показан на син фон'. The clause on switching to low beam is now a short behavioural reminder.
changes.reason: The picture shows a white symbol on a blue field. The shorter clause avoids restating чл. 70, ал. 2 ЗДвП without a reference in a general entry.

changes.change: [factual] 'а тези неизправности не повреждат пряко двигателя' became 'и не означават пряка опасност за двигателя'.
changes.reason: An applied parking brake, one of the other indicators, is not a fault.

changes.change: [legal reference] Added the lead-in чл. 5, ал. 2 ЗДвП („Водачът на пътно превозно средство е длъжен“) before the existing quote from т. 2. Kept kind law.
changes.reason: The text says that ЗДвП obliges the driver, and the т. 2 quote alone does not contain the duty. The provision expressly treats vehicle noise as a burden on other road users and on people living by the road and requires the noise norms to be met, so it is a fitting basis and the entry stays law (style guide: prefer law when a provision fits).

changes.change: [style] The three correct answers are now named by their own words in „…“ („загуба на енергия“, „увеличаване на разхода на гориво“, „износване на автомобилните гуми“) instead of a loose paraphrase without quotation marks („увеличен разход на гориво“, „износване на гумите“).
changes.reason: Style guide: answers are referred to by their words in „…“.
The same text, and the answers, write 'mm'; the units are now consistent.

changes.change: [legal reference] The junction sign is now named А27 „Кръстовище с път без предимство отдясно“, with a reference to чл. 41 of the signs ordinance.
changes.reason: Style guide: signs are named by their code and name from the ordinance. The picture shows a thick vertical line with a thinner road joining from the right, i.e. А27.

changes.change: [legal reference] The reference for А35.2 is now ППЗДвП чл. 44, ал. 5 („Пътни знаци А35.1, А35.2 и А35.3 указват разстоянието от мястото, където са поставени, до железопътен прелез …“) in place of the signs ordinance чл. 47, ал. 1, т. 2 („на 160 m - пътен знак А35.2“). Text unchanged.
changes.reason: The text says the balise 'shows the distance to the crossing'; the old quote only gave the 160 m placement, which the text does not mention. ППЗДвП чл. 44, ал. 5 states exactly what the text claims.

changes.change: [legal reference] Extended the quote of the signs ordinance чл. 35, ал. 1 to the end of the sentence („… в който е възможна внезапна поява на деца върху платното за движение“).
changes.reason: The text says that А19 warns of children who may appear on the carriageway; the old quote stopped at „се използва за сигнализиране на пътен участък“ and did not show that.

changes.change: [legal reference] Rewrote the text and replaced чл. 5, ал. 2 + т. 1 ЗДвП with § 6, т. 75 ЗДвП (children and drivers of two-wheelers are vulnerable road users) and чл. 80, ал. 1 + т. 2 ЗДвП (the cyclist must ride as close as possible to the right edge of the carriageway). The text now names both reasons: the children are vulnerable road users, and riding next to the middle leaves little lateral distance when passing.
changes.reason: The question asks whether there is a danger, not what the driver must do. § 6, т. 75 names children expressly as vulnerable road users, which is the direct basis for „да, защото велосипедистите са деца“; чл. 80, ал. 1, т. 2 shows why a cyclist riding next to the middle (as in the picture) is out of the expected place. The old references only covered two-wheelers in general, and the children-specific reason rested on no provision.

changes.change: [factual] Rewrote the text: ЗДвП чл. 28, ал. 2 allows the horn as an additional manoeuvre signal only outside settlements and even there does not make it obligatory („може“); inside settlements чл. 30 forbids it except to prevent an accident. Same two references, чл. 28, ал. 2 now first.
changes.reason: The statement is that the driver 'must' sound the horn before overtaking. The old text rested only on the scene being inside a settlement, which the picture suggests (buildings on both sides) but no sign shows. The 'may, never must' point of чл. 28, ал. 2 makes the answer „неправилно“ correct regardless of that assumption.

changes.change: [picture] 'пред автомобила вдясно се движи дете с велосипед' became 'автомобилът се движи по улица в населено място: вдясно пред него кара велосипедист'.
changes.reason: Nothing in the picture shows that the cyclist on the right is a child (the question does not say so either). The residential street with houses and parked cars supports the settlement, on which the later horn clause (чл. 30) rests.

changes.change: [legal reference] Replaced чл. 5, ал. 2 + т. 1 ЗДвП with the definition § 6, т. 75 ЗДвП („"Уязвими участници в движението" са … както и водачите на двуколесни пътни превозни средства“). Text unchanged.
changes.reason: The text says that ЗДвП classifies drivers of two-wheelers as vulnerable road users; that is the definition in § 6, т. 75. чл. 5, ал. 2, т. 1 is the driver's duty of care, which the text does not invoke.

changes.change: [legal reference] Added ЗДвП чл. 116 („… длъжен да бъде внимателен и предпазлив към пешеходците, особено към децата“) and a clause on that duty in the text, so that „преминаване на възможно по-голямо разстояние от тях“ has a basis.
changes.reason: чл. 117 (reduce speed, emergency stop if needed) covered „движение с готовност за спиране“ and „намаляване на скоростта“, but not the larger distance; the duty of care towards children on the pavement (чл. 116) does.

changes.change: [legal reference] Extended the quote of ППЗДвП чл. 77, ал. 1 to the whole sentence, from „Водач, който има намерение да извърши маневра, е длъжен …“.
changes.reason: The text says the driver 'е длъжен' to signal; the old quote („преди да започне маневрата - да подаде …“) left out the duty.
